WITH curr_order AS (
  SELECT id, status FROM shreeji_app.orders WHERE order_id = $1
),
updated AS (
  UPDATE shreeji_app.orders
  SET status = $2, updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE order_id = $1
  RETURNING id, order_id, status
),
logged AS (
  INSERT INTO shreeji_app.order_status_history (
    order_id,
    previous_status,
    new_status,
    updated_by,
    updated_by_name,
    remarks
  )
  SELECT u.id, c.status, $2, $3, $4, $5
  FROM updated u
  CROSS JOIN curr_order c
)
SELECT u.order_id, c.status AS old_status, u.status AS new_status
FROM updated u
CROSS JOIN curr_order c;

WITH client_report AS (
  SELECT 
    c.hospital_name, 
    c.client_code,
    COUNT(o.id)::INT AS total_orders,
    COALESCE(SUM(o.total_lots), 0)::INT AS total_lots,
    COALESCE(SUM(o.total_quantity), 0)::NUMERIC(10,2) AS total_quantity,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status = 'Delivered' THEN 1 END)::INT AS delivered,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status = 'Cancelled' THEN 1 END)::INT AS cancelled
  FROM shreeji_app.clients c
  LEFT JOIN shreeji_app.orders o ON c.id = o.client_id AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
  GROUP BY c.id, c.hospital_name, c.client_code
  ORDER BY total_orders DESC
),
product_report AS (
  SELECT 
    p.name AS product_name,
    p.product_code,
    COUNT(o.id)::INT AS order_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(o.total_quantity), 0)::NUMERIC(10,2) AS total_quantity
  FROM shreeji_app.products p
  LEFT JOIN shreeji_app.orders o ON p.id = o.product_id AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
  GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.product_code
  ORDER BY order_count DESC
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT json_agg(c) FROM client_report c) AS clients,
  (SELECT json_agg(p) FROM product_report p) AS products;
